title: Marcos 'perplexed' by Pax Silica rallies
summary: SHENZHEN, China -- President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. on Friday admitted he was puzzled by the massive protests staged across the country against the proposed Pax Silica initiative.

blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. on Friday admitted he was puzzled by the massive protests staged across the country against the proposed Pax Silica initiative.
Speaking before reporters here, Marcos stressed that there are no specific provisions yet regarding the Pax Silica as there was nothing signed yet.
“I’m a little bit perplexed by the demonstrations in the Pax Silica because number one, there’s no deal yet,” Marcos said.
“If they are demonstrating against specific provisions, I don’t see that’s possible, there are no specific provisions. We haven’t done it yet,” he added.
During US President Donald Trump's visit to the Philippines early this week, both Marcos and US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton said there was no signing of the initiative yet.
"No, not on this trip. We are not doing it. We are not covering that on this trip," Marcos said.

Announced in April, the Pax Silica initiative is a US-led effort to build a network of allied supply chains for critical technologies and minerals, which the Philippines will host in New Clark City in Tarlac.
